description: WP-O1b player path: the Ork datasheets the codex re-kitted show the printed codex weapons on their in-game datasheet cards. Boots to the real MainMenu, picks the shipped Codex: Orks test list (armies/ork11e_codex_test.json: Boyz, Tankbustas, Warbikers) as Player 1 (script-selected OptionButton item + item_selected, which is what a dropdown click does), real-clicks Start Game, then opens each unit's datasheet card through the DatasheetModal hotkey hook (the same open_for the I key calls; as custodes_lions_vs_recon does) and closes it with a real Escape key. Asserts against Datasheets.csv `loadout`: Tankbustas = Nob Choppa + Rokkit Pistol, Tankbusta Busta Rokkit Launcha + Gitstikka (no 40kdc Close combat weapon); Boyz = Nob Kustom Choppa + Kombi-skorcha, Boy Choppa + Shoota + Slugga (no Big Choppa / Power Klaw / Big Shoota options); Warbikers = Biker Nob Kustom Choppa + Dual Kombi-rokkit, Warbiker Choppa + Dual Dakkagun (no Twin dakkagun). Also checks the engine's per-model kit (Tankbustas melee: Choppa on the Nob, Gitstikka on every Tankbusta; Warbikers ranged: Dual Kombi-rokkit on the Biker Nob) and the unswapped Dual Kombi-rokkit profiles.

steps.script: ArmyListManager.get_available_armies().has("ork11e_codex_test")

steps.comment: script-driven: the Player 1 OptionButton is set to the Codex: Orks test list exactly as a dropdown click would (select + item_selected)

steps.script: main.get_node("ScrollContainer").ensure_control_visible(main.get_node("ScrollContainer/MenuContainer/ButtonSection/StartButton"))
GameState.state["factions"]["1"]["name"]
GameState.get_units_for_player(1).size()
GameState.get_unit("U_TANKBUSTAS_A")["models"].size()

steps.comment: the roster carries the codex wargear lines generate-armies rebuilt
steps.script: return GameState.get_unit("U_TANKBUSTAS_A")["meta"]["wargear"]

var m = tree.root.get_node_or_null("Main/DatasheetModal")
return m != null and m.t39_synthesize_i_press("U_TANKBUSTAS_A")

var t = tree.root.get_node("Main/DatasheetModal").weapons_text
return [t.contains("
  Busta Rokkit Launcha – Standard — "), t.contains("
  Busta Rokkit Launcha – Hunter — "), t.contains("
  Rokkit Pistol — "), t.contains("
  Choppa — "), t.contains("
  Gitstikka — "), t.contains("Close combat weapon")]
tree.root.get_node("Main/DatasheetModal").visible

var m = tree.root.get_node_or_null("Main/DatasheetModal")
return m != null and m.t39_synthesize_i_press("U_BOYZ_B")

var t = tree.root.get_node("Main/DatasheetModal").weapons_text
return [t.contains("
  Kustom Choppa — "), t.contains("
  Kombi-skorcha – Skorcha — "), t.contains("
  Choppa — "), t.contains("
  Shoota — "), t.contains("
  Slugga — "), t.contains("Big Choppa"), t.contains("Power Klaw"), t.contains("Big Shoota")]
tree.root.get_node("Main/DatasheetModal").visible

var m = tree.root.get_node_or_null("Main/DatasheetModal")
return m != null and m.t39_synthesize_i_press("U_WARBIKERS_A")

var t = tree.root.get_node("Main/DatasheetModal").weapons_text
return [t.contains("
  Dual Kombi-rokkit – Dakkagun — "), t.contains("
  Dual Kombi-rokkit – Busta Rokkit — "), t.contains("
  Dual Dakkagun — "), t.contains("
  Kustom Choppa — "), t.contains("
  Choppas — "), t.contains("Twin dakkagun"), t.contains("Close combat weapon")]

steps.comment: engine per-model kit: the Nob's Choppa, a Gitstikka on every Tankbusta
the Biker Nob carries the Dual Kombi-rokkit (both profiles), the Warbikers a Dual Dakkagun
Dual Kombi-rokkit profiles carry their own printed numbers (Dakkagun 18in A6 S5, Busta Rokkit 24in A2 S10)
equals: Dual Kombi-rokkit – Busta Rokkit 24 A2 S10
